views.text: In March 2024, Equity Mates highlighted United Airlines inspections found at least five more 737 MAX aircraft with loose door plugs after a door plug flew off, raising safety and reliability concerns for flights operated by the airline.

episode.title: The magic of compounding, Speccy Magee returns & when does Boeing become a good investment?

views.text: In July 2022, Equity Mates said an internal memo from United Airlines argued most delays and cancellations were due to air traffic control labour shortages, in a discussion of industry-wide travel chaos affecting the airline's service.

episode.title: Who's to blame for air travel chaos: Airlines or airports?
